chapter_title: Concerning the Gathering in of the [E]lements.

spiritual_reading.full_translation: Wisdom is to be withdrawn into love; and love itself is to be withdrawn into the receptive understanding; and that understanding is to be withdrawn into a more interior power that impels and carries it; and that power is to be withdrawn into the encompassing general order that contains and arranges it; and that encompassing order is to be withdrawn into the clear perception that can respond from truth; and that response is to be withdrawn into the ruling influx that calls, disposes, and governs all things. This ruling influx is then to be directed into a mind made pure from falsity and disorder, which is the genuinely intellectual degree. The genuinely intellectual degree is to be drawn into the steadfast support of Divine manifestation; and that support into the first fully formed heavenly person; and that heavenly person into the mediating function that conjoins what is higher with what is lower; and that mediation into the whole expanse of the Divine realm in its greatness. This is the manner of their reunion; yet this complete reunion is to occur only once, and afterward all that has been gathered in this order is to be raised into an eternal peace, beyond further scattering or struggle.

paragraph_translations.translation: Wisdom is to be withdrawn into love; and love itself is to be withdrawn into the receptive understanding; and the receptive understanding is to be withdrawn into a more interior power that gives it motion; and that power is to be withdrawn into the general encompassing sphere that contains and orders it; and that encompassing sphere is to be withdrawn into the clear perception that can answer from truth; and that answer is to be withdrawn into the governing influx that summons and disposes all things. The governing influx is then directed into a mind purified from falsity and disorder, which is the genuinely intellectual degree. The genuinely intellectual degree is drawn into the steadfast support of Divine manifestation; and that support into the first fully formed heavenly person; and that heavenly person into the mediating office that conjoins higher and lower; and that mediation into the total expanse of the Divine realm in its greatness.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it lays out an ordered return of all degrees and powers into higher unities culminating in the Divine realm.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Wind,” “air,” “answer,” and “summons” required functional translation from context rather than strict lookup; the bracketed sequence was treated as a continuous chain of higher conjunction.

paragraph_translations.translation: They are reunited in this order; yet this total reunion is to occur only once, and then all that has been thus gathered is lifted into an everlasting state of rest, beyond any later dispersal.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it seals the process with its finality and eternal outcome.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single teaching: it presents a consistent upward re-integration from wisdom through successive higher unities into the Divine fullness, then concludes with a one-time consummation and eternal rest. The only mild strain is the middle vocabulary shift (from elemental terms to cognitive/volitional terms), but the chain remains intelligible as a graded return of spiritual degrees.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential “return-chain” teaching: a functional sequence of transformations/assimilations culminating in rest. The reader’s only strain (“wind/air/answer/summons” needing contextual rendering) reflects translation difficulty, not a textual seam.
findings.evidence: Text is a continuous series of functional re-integrations: “The light shall be gathered in to the fire, and the fire itself gathered in to the water… and the air gathered to the answer, and the answer gathered to the summons. Also, the summons to the purified Mind…” This reads as process-by-states (gathering/withdrawal into higher unities), not jurisdiction-by-names. The spiritual reading reports “Highly coherent as a single teaching… only mild strain… middle vocabulary shift,” which matches a correspondential chain whose terms are compressed/technical rather than administratively catalogued.

findings.location: ¶2 (bracketed clause: “[the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to] the aeons of greatness.”)
findings.diagnosis: Insertion into a functional narrative: a named-agent ascent chain is spliced into an otherwise impersonal correspondential sequence. The bracketed run introduces administrative/personnel-style entities (“First Man,” “Ambassador”) that do not functionally participate in the element→faculty progression and look like a harmonizing bridge toward standard Manichaean dramatis personae.
findings.evidence: The chapter’s governing syntax is impersonal and functional: X is “gathered into” Y (light→fire→water→wind→air→answer→summons→Mind→intellectual→Pillar of Glory…). The bracketed material abruptly switches to named figures: “First Man… Ambassador,” which are not functional states but mythic offices/persons. The spiritual reading explicitly notes it had to “treat[] the bracketed sequence… as a continuous chain of higher conjunction,” i.e., it had to smooth over a seam by interpretive force rather than arising naturally from the functional correspondences. Removing the bracketed run yields a clean completion: “…The intellectual to the Pillar of Glory, … the aeons of greatness.”
findings.scope: Remove: “the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to”

findings.diagnosis: Clean closure; it coherently seals the one-time consummation of the gathering and the resulting eternal rest. No voice conflict or narrative break.
findings.evidence: It resumes and concludes the same process-language: “They are gathered in like this; but, they will be gathered on one occasion only, and go up above to the place of rest for ever and ever.” The spiritual reading reports it “seals the process with its finality and eternal outcome,” with no stumble points.

textual_criticism.summary: 2 clean correspondential units (¶2 opening chain; ¶3 closure) and 1 disruption: a mixed-voice insertion in ¶2 (bracketed named-figure ascent: First Man/Ambassador) that the spiritual reading had to smooth over. Recommended actions: excise 1 small inserted clause; annotate none; remaining text stands as coherent substrate.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: The light shall be gathered in to the fire, and the fire itself gathered in to the water, and the water gathered in to the wind, and the wind gathered to the air, and the air gathered to the answer, and the answer gathered to the summons. Also, the summons to the purified Mind, which is the intellectual. The intellectual to the Pillar of Glory, the aeons of greatness.
They are gathered in like this; but, they will be gathered on one occasion only, and go up above to the place of rest for ever and ever.

changes_summary: Applied Finding 2 (¶2) excision: removed the bracketed named-figure ascent clause “the Pillar of Glory to the First Man, the Man to the Ambassador, the Ambassador to” to restore the impersonal correspondential return-chain. No other changes (Findings 1 and 3 recommend none).
